'''Darth Lokess''' was an individual of<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> [[Human/Legends|Human]] or [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith pureblood]] descent<ref name="Species" /> who held the title of [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] and was a member of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire's]] ruling [[Dark Council]] during the first few [[Time/Legends|centuries]] of the Empire's existence. During a violent storm on the Imperial [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], Darth Lokess summoned the other eleven Councilors to a meeting and convinced them to join her [[Darth Lokess's conspiracy|plot]] to destroy the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]], though she kept an army of loyal [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] outside of the meeting in case any of the Councilors refused. The other eleven [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] agreed to join Lokess' cause, but when they gathered on the steps of the [[Imperial Citadel (Sith Empire)|Imperial Citadel]] in order to confront the Emperor, all eleven [[Death/Legends|died]] instantly in a flash of light. Lokess was locked within the depths of the Citadel by the Emperor, who [[Torture/Legends|tortured]] her until her death.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

==Behind the scenes==
Darth Lokess was mentioned in the [[2012]] reference guide ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />
